name: 68781 · Tilden, NE
findings: ZIP 68781 (Tilden) has 10 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (70%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 68781 (Tilden) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
